metadata.query: Why should white grapes not have kids?

final_answer: The phrase "Why should white grapes not have kids?" is a joke or riddle related to wine-making. The punchline is that white grapes are not capable of reproducing on their own, as they must be pollinated by other plants or undergo artificial methods for propagation. (Source: https://www.winefolly.com/tutorial/why-white-grapes-cant-have-kids/)
